commands.name: migrate-project
commands.purpose: Audit an existing app and create a phased migration map into MinLang

commands.name: migrate-domain
commands.purpose: Extract entities, constraints, actions, and queries from one feature area

commands.name: migrate-screen
commands.purpose: Turn an existing UI route or component into MinLang screen blocks

commands.name: migrate-tests
commands.purpose: Convert existing unit/e2e expectations into MinLang tests

commands.name: migration-ledger
commands.purpose: Track migrated slices, remaining shell code, blockers, and verification

commands.name: author-app
commands.purpose: Interview the user, draft the .ml, validate, fix, and compile
commands.primary_verification: ml1 validate <file> && make compile && make test

commands.name: add-feature
commands.purpose: Make one product change by editing only MinLang source
commands.primary_verification: ml1 validate <file> && make compile && make test

commands.name: model-domain
commands.purpose: Produce the entity/action/query model before screens

commands.name: design-ui
commands.purpose: Sketch screens first, then generate or update MinLang screen blocks

commands.name: validate-authority
commands.purpose: Run the Creator/Gatekeeper preflight plus ml1 validate

commands.name: pull-domain-logic
commands.purpose: Find domain logic hiding in React/API/shell code and move it into MinLang

commands.name: dedupe-rules
commands.purpose: Detect duplicated validation, copy, and business rules across app code

commands.name: thin-shell
commands.purpose: Identify shell code that violates presentation-only boundaries

commands.name: generated-drift
commands.purpose: Compare .ml intent against generated output and stale hand edits

commands.name: explain-failure
commands.purpose: Translate ml1 validate and compile errors into concrete fixes

commands.name: why-not-supported
commands.purpose: Map a desired feature to current language support gaps

commands.name: inspect-graph
commands.purpose: Explain project graph and compile closure

commands.name: release-check
commands.purpose: Verify app compatibility with latest compiler, bundle, runtime, and generated output
commands.primary_verification: ml1 update --check && make compile && make test

commands.name: product-interview
commands.purpose: Ask only the product questions needed to produce a valid MinLang app

commands.name: legacy-strangler
commands.purpose: Plan a slice-by-slice migration from a legacy app to MinLang

commands.name: boundary-police
commands.purpose: Scan for logic that belongs in .ml but leaked into generated or shell code

commands.name: demo-from-idea
commands.purpose: Go from one paragraph idea to compiled app, tests, and dev server
commands.primary_verification: ml1 validate <file> && make compile && make test && make dev

commands.name: bundle-upgrade-coach
commands.purpose: Guide an app across bundle versions using ml1 update and migration notes
